lines.text: The LORD tells the barren woman to shout for joy and enlarge her tent, for her descendants will spread right and left.
The LORD says her husband is her Maker, and He has called her back like a deserted wife.
The LORD forsook her for a brief moment, and He swore to Abraham that the waters would never again cover the earth.
The LORD will build the afflicted city with sapphire foundations and ruby pinnacles, and all her sons will be taught by the LORD.
Whoever attacks her will fall before her, and no weapon formed against her will prosper.
